note: Gap junctions known from physiology/genetics but invisible in EM connectomes. Modelled as true electrical coupling: a presynaptic spike adds 'coupling_mv' directly to the postsynaptic membrane voltage on the next 0.5 ms step (shaders/lif.glsl mode 2), giving the ~1 ms latency and 1:1 following reported for the giant-fibre system. basis: literature (existence, 1:1 following, latency) + approximate (coupling strength: just above the 7 mV threshold).

pairs.source: GF-TTMn mixed electrical/chemical synapse, ShakB; 1:1 following, ~0.8 ms latency (Allen et al. 2006 J Neurosci; Phelan et al. 2008; Tanouye & Wyman 1980)
GF-PSI electrical synapse (King & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006)
